title: 上海高考翻译背诵-62-25奉贤一模

items.zh: 农忙季节，这个偏远的小村子显得空荡荡的。
items.en: During the busy farming season, the remote small village lies deserted.

items.zh: 上海博物馆的埃及展太火爆了，根本抢不到票。
items.en: The Egypt exhibition at the Shanghai Museum is so popular that it is virtually impossible to secure a ticket.

items.zh: 虽然这部经典老片在1998年首映，但它本月重新上映时，依然在影迷中引起了极大的反响。
items.en: Although the classic film was first released back in 1998, it caused a sensation among film fans upon its re-release this month.

items.zh: 这位原常深耕于科研领域的女学者，凭借自己坚持不懈的努力，历经严格的训练，最终成为了一名宇航员。
items.en: Originally engaged in scientific research, the female scholar eventually became an astronaut through years of persistent effort and rigorous training.

note: 原标题期号为 62，按人工核对改为第 64 期
